<style>/* ===== Mockup content styles (scoped to :is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar)). Type and buttons follow the live homepage. ===== */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar){--g:#73B01E;--ink:#161616;--mute:#555;--line:#e3e3e3;--soft:#f4f4f4;
  --cond:"Founders Grotesk X-Condensed",founders-grotesk-x-condensed,"Arial Narrow",sans-serif;
  --roo:Roobert,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:HelveticaNeue-Light,"Helvetica Neue Light","Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,"Lucida Grande",sans-serif;
  font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--ink);text-align:left}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) *{box-sizing:border-box}

:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) p{font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.4px;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--ink)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) a{color:inherit}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) ul,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) ol{margin:0 0 14px;padding-left:20px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) li{font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--mute)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .bleed{width:100vw;position:relative;left:50%;margin-left:-50vw}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec{padding:72px 0}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec.soft{background:var(--soft)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec.dark{background:#000}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec.dark p,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec.dark h2,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sec.dark h3{color:#fff}

/* headings: homepage scale */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) h1,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) h2,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) h3,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) h4{margin:0;padding:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-hero{font-family:var(--cond);font-weight:700;font-size:120px;line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin:0 0 22px;max-width:1180px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-sec{font-family:var(--cond);font-weight:400;font-size:40px;line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;color:#000;margin:0 0 16px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-sec .gr{color:rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .dark .h-sec{color:#fff}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .dark .h-sec .gr{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-sub{font-family:var(--roo);font-size:30px;line-height:1;color:#fff;margin:0 0 30px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-sub b{font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-sub span{font-weight:300;display:block}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-card{font-family:var(--roo);font-weight:600;font-size:18px;line-height:1.15;color:#000;margin:0 0 10px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .h-small{font-family:var(--roo);font-weight:400;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3;color:#000}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .lead{max-width:780px;font-size:18px;color:var(--mute)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .eyebrow{font-family:var(--roo);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--g);margin:0 0 12px;display:block}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .eyebrow{color:#fff}

/* buttons: homepage elementor-button styles */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b{flex-direction:row-reverse;justify-content:center;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--roo);font-weight:400;font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:0;border:0;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;background:#000;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:currentColor;flex:0 0 auto}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-g{background:var(--g);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-g:hover{background:rgba(115,176,30,.85)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-ow{background:transparent;border:1px solid #fff;font-size:18px;gap:15px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-ow:hover{background:#fff;color:#000;text-shadow:none}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-ob{background:transparent;border:1px solid #000;color:#000}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .b-ob:hover{background:#000;color:#fff}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .b{font-size:18px;gap:15px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .tlink{font-family:var(--roo);font-size:15px;text-decoration:none;color:#000;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .tlink::after{content:"\203A";font-size:20px;line-height:1}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .tlink:hover{color:var(--g)}

/* hero */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero{position:relative;min-height:640px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background:#000}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .bg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.2) 100%)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .wrap{position:relative;width:100%;padding-top:100px;padding-bottom:64px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .call{margin:18px 0 0;color:#e6e6e6;font-size:16px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .hero .call a{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 32px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .chips span{font-family:var(--roo);font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#000}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .chips span::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--g)}

/* state block */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .state{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:28px;align-items:stretch}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office{background:#000;padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office .h-sec{color:#fff;margin:0}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office .h-sec .gr,:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .cta-card .h-sec .gr{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office p{color:#d6d6d6;margin:0}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office .lic{font-size:13px;color:#999}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .office .row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:auto;padding-top:10px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .feature img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;min-height:300px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .feature .txt{padding:28px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .tag{display:inline-block;background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:var(--roo);font-size:12px;padding:4px 10px;margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}

/* cards */
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}

:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .card .acts{margin-top:auto;display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:6px}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .card .code{font-family:var(--roo);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--g);margin:0 0 6px}

:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .sys .card > img{aspect-ratio:4/5}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .proj .card > img{aspect-ratio:3/2}
:is(#dcm-e1,#dcm-e2,#dcm-e3,#dcm-e4,#dcm-e5,#dcm-locks,#dcm-quote,#dcm-e6,#dcm-specify,#dcm-e7,#dcm-mbar) .spot .card > img{aspect-ratio:1/1}

<script>(function(){
  function target(name){return document.getElementById('dcm-'+name);}

    var a=e.target.closest('[data-goto]'); if(!a) return;
    var sec=target(a.getAttribute('data-goto')); if(!sec) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var need=a.getAttribute('data-need');
    if(need){var s=document.querySelector('#dcm-quote select'); if(s){for(var i=0;i<s.options.length;i++){if(s.options[i].text===need){s.selectedIndex=i;s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));break;}}}}
    var hdr=document.querySelector('header'); var off=(hdr&&getComputedStyle(hdr).position!=='static')?hdr.offsetHeight+20:20;
    window.scrollTo({top:sec.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.pageYOffset-off,behavior:'smooth'});
  },true);
})();</script>

Toilet partitions

School toilet partitions & cubicles

Two systems cover most school toilet blocks: full-height privacy cubicles for inclusive and unisex amenities, and pedestal-mounted cubicles for high-traffic student toilets.

FHPC

Full Height – Privacy Core

Floor-to-ceiling cubicles with no gaps to see through, for inclusive and all-gender school toilets. Built to let air flow through, so they meet the NCC without extra mechanical ventilation.

  • Full-height privacy at an economical price
  • Suits unisex and all-gender amenities
  • Waterproof 13mm DuraSafe compact laminate

Pedestal Mount – Overhead Braced

Raised pedestals and an overhead aluminium rail for student toilets that take a beating. Nothing sits on the floor to trap water, so the block can be hosed out.

  • Resists impact and vandalism
  • Graffiti-resistant and easy to clean
  • Raised design for fast washdown

New for 2026

Tamper-Proof lock indicator

Toilet locks are one of the first things to get damaged in a school. Our new Tamper-Proof lock indicator was developed with architects working in schools to stand up to it.

It comes with our toilet partition systems and is available on all of them. It isn't supplied as separate hardware.

  • Heavy-duty lock indicator
  • Resists coins, tools and tampering
  • Secure key override for authorised staff in an emergency
